svg.title: A 35-minute whiteboard round and a 90-minute machine-coding round on the same minute scale
svg.desc: Whiteboard: requirements 0 to 5, entities 5 to 8, class design 8 to 20, code 20 to 30, extensibility 30 to 35. Machine coding: requirements and questions 0 to 10, entities and class outline 10 to 20, code the happy path 20 to 50, edge cases and validation 50 to 70, run the demo and make the change they ask for 70 to 85, buffer 85 to 90. Code takes 10 of 35 minutes on the whiteboard and 50 of 90 in machine coding.
svg.text: same stages, different clock: where the minutes go
code: 10 of 35 minutes on the whiteboard, 50 of 90 in machine coding
